about.title: About Jynx
about.subtitle: Transforming gaming from solo to social

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: Founded in 2024, Jynx was born from a simple yet powerful vision: to transform how gamers connect and play together. We understand the frustration of wasting precious gaming time searching for compatible teammates or struggling to find players who match your skill level and gaming style.
story.p2: Our platform serves as the bridge between solo gaming experiences and fulfilling team play, allowing you to quickly find your perfect gaming companions based on skill level, playing style, and personality.

problem.title: The Problem We're Solving
problem.intro: As gamers ourselves, we've experienced the challenges firsthand:

points.time: Spending more time searching for teammates than actually playing
points.mismatch: Getting matched with players whose skills or goals don't align with yours
points.disconnected: Feeling disconnected from the broader gaming community
points.relationships: Struggling to build lasting gaming relationships

problem.conclusion: Jynx addresses these pain points with innovative matchmaking systems designed specifically for gamers, by gamers.

arthur.name: Arthur Bonvallet
arthur.bio: A passionate gamer and experienced product specialist from Paris, Arthur brings his deep understanding of user experience and product development to Jynx. His vision drives our platform's intuitive design and feature set.

antoine.name: Antoine Haie
antoine.bio: Antoine's technical expertise as a fullstack developer powers the Jynx platform. Based in Paris, his gaming background combined with his technical skills ensures our platform delivers a seamless experience for gamers of all levels.

elo.title: ELO-Based Match Queue
elo.description: Our sophisticated matching algorithm considers your skill level (ELO) to connect you with teammates and opponents who provide the right level of challenge and compatibility.

chat.title: Global Chat System
chat.description: Stay connected with the broader gaming community through our vibrant global chat system, where you can discuss strategies, share experiences, or simply hang out with fellow gamers.

guilds.title: Guild-Based Communities
guilds.description: Find your gaming home with our unique "guild" system. Join existing communities based on your favorite games or playing styles, or create your own guild and become a community leader. Build your reputation, establish your team culture, and grow your network of gaming allies.

for_everyone.title: For Every Gamer
for_everyone.p1: Whether you're a casual player looking for fun companions or a competitive gamer seeking serious teammates for tournament play, Jynx welcomes all. Our platform supports communities across all game types, genres, and platforms.
for_everyone.p2: Don't see a community for your favorite game? Create one and become its founding leader! At Jynx, we believe in empowering gamers to build and nurture their own spaces.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.p1: Jynx is more than just a platform—it's a growing community of gamers who believe that gaming is better together. We're just getting started, and we invite you to be part of our journey as we revolutionize how gamers connect, compete, and collaborate.

cta.title: Join the Jynx Community
cta.description: Be the first to experience a new way of finding your perfect gaming squad

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.p1: Jynx ("we", "our", "the application") is a social gaming platform that allows players to connect, form teams and play together.
intro.entity: Jynx Group (Société par Actions Simplifiée, SIREN 991443896, registered in Nantes, France)
intro.jurisdiction_eu: France, European Union — this Privacy Policy complies with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Directive 2002/58/EC (ePrivacy), as transposed in France.
intro.jurisdiction_brazil: This Privacy Policy also complies with Brazilian Law nº 13.709/2018 (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados, "LGPD"), which applies to Jynx's processing of personal data of data subjects located in Brazil under Art. 3 of the LGPD, regardless of Jynx having no establishment in Brazil.
intro.controller: For the purposes of the LGPD, Jynx Group is the controller (controlador) of your personal data. Our Data Protection Officer acts as the encarregado (DPO) and may be reached at dpo@jynx.app for any request relating to the LGPD. Although Jynx qualifies as a pequeno agente de tratamento de dados pessoais (small-scale agent) under ANPD Resolution CD/ANPD nº 2/2022, which exempts Jynx from the obligatory appointment of an encarregado, Jynx voluntarily maintains this published communication channel.
intro.p2: This privacy policy describes how we collect, use, share and protect your personal data when you use our application.

age_verification.title: 2. Minimum Age and Verification
age_verification.p1: Our application is reserved for users aged 18 and over.
age_verification.p2: When creating your account, we ask you to provide your date of birth. If you are under 18, you will not be able to create an account or use our services.
age_verification.minors: Marketing to minors. Jynx is restricted to users aged 18 and over and applies an automated age gate. If we subsequently identify that a user is under 18 (LGPD Art. 14; GDPR Art. 8), we will immediately terminate the account, exclude the user from all marketing, re-engagement, and survey communications, and delete the associated marketing data. We never knowingly collect marketing consent from a minor.

registration.title: 3.1. Registration and Profile Data
registration.intro: We collect the following information when creating and managing your account:

auth.title: Authentication Information:
auth.social: Social login identifiers (Google, Apple) if you use these methods

profile.title: Profile Information:
profile.handle: Unique handle (automatically generated for private friend discovery)

gaming.title: 3.2. Gaming Data
gaming.intro: To help you find compatible teammates, we collect:

riot.title: Riot Games API Integration:
riot.intro: We retrieve from the Riot Games API (with your consent):
riot.rank: Rank and match history (League of Legends, Valorant, etc.)
riot.reason: Display your player profile and improve matching with other players.

technical.title: 3.3. Usage and Technical Data
technical.intro: We automatically collect certain technical data:

analytics.sentry: Error and performance reports (with personal data anonymization)
analytics.disable: You can disable analytics data collection in Settings > Privacy > "Enable Analytics".

communication.title: 3.4. Communication Data
communication.messages: Messages in community chats, private messages between users, conversation history
communication.notifications: FCM tokens (Firebase Cloud Messaging) for push notifications

firebase.title: 4.1. Firebase Services (Google)
firebase.intro: We use the following Firebase services, all GDPR compliant:
firebase.firestore: Storage of your profile and game data

sentry.title: 4.2. Sentry (Error Monitoring)
sentry.intro: We use Sentry for error and performance tracking. Collected data includes:

riot.title: 4.3. Riot Games API
riot.p1: When you link your Riot Games account, we retrieve your game statistics via the official Riot Games API. This data is used only to display your profile and improve matching.

esp.title: 4.4. Email Service Provider (Marketing & Survey Communications)
esp.intro: To deliver the marketing, re-engagement, and uninstall/churn-survey emails described in §5.6, Jynx uses a third-party email service provider (ESP) acting as a processor (GDPR Art. 28; LGPD Art. 39 — operador). The ESP processes your email address and minimal delivery data (e.g., send/bounce status) solely on Jynx's documented instructions, under a signed Data Processing Agreement.
esp.identity: Brevo (Brevo SAS, Paris, France) — our Email Service Provider and data processor under a signed Data Processing Agreement. Brevo Privacy Policy: https://www.brevo.com/legal/privacypolicy/
esp.subprocessors: Brevo's current list of sub-processors is published in its Data Processing Agreement (Terms of Use): https://www.brevo.com/legal/termsofuse/
esp.transfer: See §9. Brevo is headquartered in France (EU). Transfers to Brevo therefore benefit from the EU's protection regime under GDPR and, for Brazilian users, the ANPD adequacy decision for the EU (Resolution nº 32/2026) — no SCCs or additional mechanism are required.
esp.no_sell: We do not sell your personal data. No tracking pixels or hidden analytics are embedded in marketing emails without a separate legal basis disclosed in §5.6.

services.title: 1. Provide Our Services:
services.connect: Allow you to connect with other players
services.teams: Facilitate team creation and gaming session organization

personalization.title: 2. Personalization:
personalization.matching: Recommend compatible teammates (game-based, rank, style matching)

communication.title: 3. Communication (operational / transactional):
communication.notifications: Send you important service notifications (matches found, messages received, account-security alerts, and policy-change notices under §11)
communication.note: Marketing, re-engagement, and uninstall/churn-survey emails are described separately in §5.6 Marketing Communications and are not covered by this transactional category.

marketing.title: 5.6. Marketing Communications
marketing.intro: In addition to the operational notifications described in §5.3, we may send you marketing and re-engagement communications by email, including: product updates and feature announcements about the Jynx app; newsletters; re-engagement messages inviting you back to the app; and short uninstall or churn feedback surveys (e.g., "Why did you stop using Jynx?"). These communications are distinct from transactional/service notifications.
marketing.eu_title: Legal basis — European Union / EEA users (GDPR + ePrivacy).
marketing.eu_body: Because the Service is currently provided without remuneration (no paid tier is purchasable at the date of this Policy), marketing and re-engagement emails to EU/EEA users are sent only on the basis of your prior explicit opt-in consent (ePrivacy Directive Art. 13(1), transposed in France by Article L. 34-5 of the Code des postes et des communications électroniques; GDPR Art. 6(1)(a) and Art. 7). We do not rely on the "soft opt-in" exception of ePrivacy Art. 13(2) at this time, because that exception requires a "sale" within the meaning of the CJEU judgment C-654/23 (13 Nov 2025) and the Service is not yet remunerated. We will re-assess this analysis if and when a paid premium tier or any other monetization (in-app purchases, advertising, data licensing) goes live, and this Policy will be updated accordingly.
marketing.br_intro: For Brazilian users, marketing and re-engagement communications rely on two alternative legal bases:
marketing.br_consent_body: captured as a separate, un-ticked, purpose-specific opt-in at signup or in-app, recorded with date, form version, and language; you may withdraw it at any time, free of charge, without losing access to the Service (Art. 8 §5). Consent is the basis used for any communication to prospects, cold outreach, or cross-sell/partner offers beyond the core Jynx app.
marketing.br_li_title: Legitimate interest (LGPD Art. 7, IX, elaborated by Art. 10)
marketing.br_li_body: used only for existing or recently-lapsed users receiving re-engagement messages, product updates about the same Jynx app, or a single short churn/uninstall feedback survey. Before relying on this basis, Jynx conducts and documents a Legitimate Interests Assessment (LIA) following the three-phase test of the ANPD Legitimate Interest Guide (2 Feb 2024): (i) purpose, (ii) necessity, and (iii) balancing and safeguards. The LIA records the prior relationship, the user's reasonable expectations, the purpose, the least-intrusive means chosen, and the opt-out channel. Legitimate interest is not used for cold/unsolicited email, unrelated cross-sell, purchased lists, or persistent messaging to departed users after the relationship has clearly ended.
marketing.optout_body: Brazilian users may at any time oppose this processing and opt out via the mechanisms in §7.5 and §7.6 (one-click unsubscribe in every email, or the in-app communications-preferences toggle), without cost and without terminating the account. We honor opt-out requests in real time. The Brazilian Consumer Defense Code (CDC, Law 8.078/90, in particular Art. 39 III) prohibits unsolicited or abusive commercial messaging; we therefore strictly respect opt-outs and apply frequency caps, since persistent or ignored-opt-out sending may be treated as an abusive practice.
marketing.surveys_body: Wherever operationally feasible we ask uninstall/churn questions in-app at the uninstall moment (no email retention required). Where an email survey is sent, the survey contains no promotional or re-engagement content; we send a maximum of one (1) survey per user within approximately 60 days of account deletion or uninstall; the email address is then deleted or anonymized in accordance with §6; and users who have submitted an erasure / right-to-be-forgotten request (§7.3) are never re-contacted and are placed on a permanent suppression list (see §6 and the Terms of Service §7.2).
marketing.tracking_body: Marketing emails do not embed tracking pixels or hidden analytics that process personal data without a separate legal basis. Where any open/click tracking is introduced, it will be disclosed here and based on consent (LGPD Art. 8; ePrivacy Art. 5(3)), consistent with the ANPD guidance on tracking technologies (18 Oct 2022).
marketing.frequency_body: Marketing emails are subject to internal frequency caps; you can reduce or turn them off at any time via the in-app communications-preferences toggle or by clicking unsubscribe in any message.

periods.title: 6.1. Retention Periods
periods.profile: Retained as long as your account is active
periods.marketing: Retained for as long as you have not opted out or deleted your account, plus a hashed record on the suppression list (see below) to ensure we do not re-contact you
periods.survey: Retained for a maximum of 60 days after the survey is sent (or, if no survey is sent, 60 days after uninstall/deletion), after which the address is deleted or irreversibly anonymized. No more than one (1) survey email is sent per user
periods.reengagement_label: Re-engagement of recently-lapsed accounts (LGPD legitimate-interest basis, Brazilian users only):
periods.reengagement: Consistent with CNIL guidance and the reasonable-expectations test, Jynx may use the email address of a recently-lapsed (non-erasure) account for re-engagement for up to 3 years after the last meaningful interaction, after which it is deleted or anonymized

deletion.title: 6.2. Data Deletion
deletion.p1: You can request deletion of your account at any time (see Section 7).
deletion.legal: Some data may be retained longer to comply with our legal obligations (e.g., security reports, financial transactions).
deletion.marketing: When you delete your account, we purge your email address from our marketing CRM and email service provider. If you exercise the right to erasure (§7.3 / GDPR Art. 17 / LGPD Art. 18(VI) for consent-based data), your email address is added to a permanent hashed suppression list so that it is never re-used for marketing, re-engagement, or surveys — including protection against re-import via any third-party or purchased list. Note: under the LGPD, Art. 18(VI) deletion applies to data processed on the basis of consent; data processed on the basis of legitimate interest (Art. 7 IX) is instead governed by the purpose-limitation principle (Art. 6 II and §2) and your right to request cessation of processing (Art. 18 §2).

rights.title: 7. Your Rights (GDPR and LGPD)
rights.intro: Depending on where you are located, you have rights under the GDPR (EU/EEA) and/or the Brazilian LGPD (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados, Law 13.709/2018).

access.title: 7.1. Right of Access
access.p1: You can request a copy of all data we hold about you.
access.process: The process generates a JSON file containing all your data (profile, messages, statistics, etc.). The download link is valid for 7 days.

rectification.title: 7.2. Right of Rectification
rectification.p1: You can modify your profile information at any time from the application (username, bio, preferences, etc.).

erasure.title: 7.3. Right to Erasure ("Right to be Forgotten")
erasure.p1: You can request deletion of your account.

process.title: Automated Deletion Process:
process.step1: Two-step confirmation to prevent accidental deletions
process.step2: Immediate anonymization of your personal data (Firestore)
process.step3: Deletion of your Firebase Authentication account (automatically revokes all OAuth tokens)
process.step4: An anonymized ID is provided as reference
process.step5: Option to delete your messages and generated content

erasure.important: Deletion is irreversible. Some anonymized data may be retained for statistical purposes (GDPR-compliant).
erasure.manual: For specific data deletion requests (e.g., delete only messages from a specific community, delete Storage images, or other edge cases), please contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@jynx.app. We will process manual requests within 30 days as required by GDPR.

portability.title: 7.4. Right to Data Portability
portability.p1: The data export (Section 7.1) allows you to retrieve your data in a structured, machine-readable format (JSON).

objection.title: 7.5. Right to Object / Opt Out of Marketing
objection.p1: You can object to the processing of your data for direct-marketing purposes at any time, free of charge and without giving reasons. Under GDPR Art. 21(2) this right is absolute for EU/EEA users: we will stop all marketing processing on receipt of your objection. For Brazilian users, you may oppose marketing processing via the opt-out mechanisms below (LGPD Art. 8 §5; Art. 18 §2).
objection.onclick: every marketing email includes a one-click unsubscribe link (RFC 8058 List-Unsubscribe-Post) honored in real time

withdraw.title: 7.6. Right to Withdraw Consent
withdraw.p1: You can withdraw your consent for:
withdraw.marketing: Newsletter, product updates, re-engagement, and uninstall/churn surveys — withdrawable via one-click unsubscribe, the in-app communications-preferences toggle, or dpo@jynx.app, without terminating your account
withdraw.oauth: OAuth tokens (Google, Apple) are automatically revoked when you delete your account (Section 7.3).
withdraw.effect: Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal (GDPR Art. 7(3); LGPD Art. 8 §5), and withdrawing consent never requires you to delete your account.

lgpd.title: 7.7. Additional LGPD Rights (Brazilian Users)
lgpd.intro: In addition to the rights above, data subjects located in Brazil have the following rights under LGPD Art. 18: confirmation of the existence of processing; access to the data; correction of incomplete, inaccurate, or out-of-date data; anonymization, blocking, or deletion of unnecessary or excessive data (Art. 18(VI) applies to data processed on the basis of consent); portability to another service or product provider, upon request; deletion of personal data processed with consent; and information about the possibility of denying consent and the consequences of doing so.
lgpd.how: You may exercise these rights via Settings > Privacy or by contacting the encarregado at dpo@jynx.app. You may also lodge a complaint with the Brazilian data protection authority — the Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados (ANPD) — at https://www.gov.br/anpd.

security.title: 8. Data Security
security.intro: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your data:
security.rules: Strict access control to Firestore data
security.auth: Secure session management via Firebase Auth
security.rate_limiting: Protection against abuse (spam messages, automated actions)
security.breach: No system is 100% secure. In case of a data breach, we will notify you in compliance with GDPR (within 72 hours).

international.title: 9. International Data Transfers
international.p1: Your data may be transferred to and stored on servers located outside your jurisdiction, including:
international.google: Global infrastructure, under GDPR standard contractual clauses and equivalent safeguards
international.sentry: U.S.-based servers; transfers from the EU/EEA rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (in force July 2023, replacing the invalidated Privacy Shield) for Sentry entities self-certified under the DPF, or on standard contractual clauses where the DPF does not apply
international.esp: Used to deliver the marketing, re-engagement, and survey communications described in §5.6. The ESP is named in §4.4 and acts as a processor under a signed Data Processing Agreement
international.guarantees_eu: All transfers from the EU/EEA are covered by an adequacy decision, the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, or standard contractual clauses, together with supplementary measures where required.
international.guarantees_br: Transfers of Brazilian users' personal data are governed by LGPD Art. 33:
international.br_france: Lawful under LGPD Art. 33(I) by virtue of ANPD Resolution CD/ANPD nº 32/2026 (in force 26 January 2026), which recognizes the European Union — including France — as providing an adequate level of protection. No additional transfer mechanism is required for this leg. (This adequacy decision is subject to reassessment by the ANPD within four years; if suspended, Jynx will implement an alternative Art. 33 mechanism such as the ANPD standard contractual clauses.)
international.br_esp_label: To Brevo in France (email ESP, processor):
international.br_esp: Lawful under LGPD Art. 33(I) by virtue of the same ANPD Resolution CD/ANPD nº 32/2026 (in force 26 January 2026), which recognizes the European Union — including France — as providing an adequate level of protection. No additional transfer mechanism is required for this leg. (Subject to the same ANPD reassessment described above; if the adequacy decision is suspended, Jynx will implement an alternative Art. 33 mechanism such as the ANPD standard contractual clauses with Brevo.)
international.historical: Historical note: the one-year grace period for adapting existing contracts to the ANPD SCCs ended on 23 August 2025; new processor relationships such as the ESP execute the SCCs at onboarding.

cookies.title: 10. Cookies and Similar Technologies
cookies.p1: Our mobile application does not use cookies in the traditional sense, but uses:
cookies.tokens: Stored locally in a secure manner
cookies.cache: To improve performance (profile data, recent messages)

changes.title: 11. Changes to This Policy
changes.p1: We may update this privacy policy. In case of major changes, we will notify you:
changes.email: By email to the address associated with your account

contact.title: 12. Contact Us
contact.p1: For any questions regarding this privacy policy or to exercise your rights:
contact.authority_intro: If you believe your rights have not been respected, you may lodge a complaint:
contact.authority_eu: with the CNIL (Commission Nationale de l'Informatique et des Libertés), France — https://www.cnil.fr
contact.authority_br: with the ANPD (Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados), Brazil — https://www.gov.br/anpd
contact.authority_note: Filing a complaint with a supervisory authority does not prejudice your right to seek other judicial remedies available to you, including the mandatory consumer protections that apply in your jurisdiction (e.g., the Brazilian Consumer Defense Code, Law 8.078/90).

consent.title: 13. Legal Bases and Consent
consent.intro: We process your personal data only where we have a lawful basis. The lawful bases we rely on, and where each is described in this Policy, are:
consent.contract: Performance of a contract / provision of the Service (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b); LGPD Art. 7, V) — account, matching, and messaging (§5.1–5.3)
consent.legitimate: Legitimate interests (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f); LGPD Art. 7, IX and Art. 10) — security, fraud prevention, service improvement, and (for Brazilian users) marketing/re-engagement/survey communications to existing or recently-lapsed users as described in §5.6, each supported by a documented balancing assessment
consent.legal: Legal obligation (GDPR Art. 6(1)(c); LGPD Art. 7, II) — retention for legal purposes (§6)
consent.consent_basis: Consent (GDPR Art. 6(1)(a); LGPD Art. 7, I and Art. 8) — analytics where you have enabled them, push notifications, and (for EU/EEA users and for Brazilian prospects/cold/cross-sell sends) marketing communications per §5.6
consent.specific_label: Consent must be specific and informed.
consent.specific: Where we rely on your consent, it is given by a clear affirmative act, refers to specified purposes, and is captured separately from your acceptance of these terms (LGPD Art. 8 §1 — cláusula destacada). Generic or bundled authorizations are void under LGPD Art. 8 §4 and invalid under GDPR Art. 4(11) and Art. 7. Using Jynx does not by itself constitute consent to marketing. The burden of proving valid consent rests with Jynx (LGPD Art. 8 §2; GDPR Art. 7(1)); we therefore record the date, form version, language, and scope of each consent we collect.
consent.withdrawal: You may withdraw any consent at any time, through a procedure that is as easy as giving it and that does not require you to delete your account (LGPD Art. 8 §5; GDPR Art. 7(3)) — see §7.5 and §7.6. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal. Deleting your account (§7.3) remains available at any time but is not the mechanism for withdrawing a specific consent.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Gaming Matchmaking

q1.question: Is there a Tinder-like app for gamers to find teammates?
q1.answer:
Yeah, and it's about time. Traditional LFG is broken — you're spamming Discord channels, posting in subreddits from 3 days ago, and hoping someone who speaks your language and plays your rank is actually online when you are. That's not a system, that's gambling with your time.

Jynx lets you filter for what actually matters: compatible schedules, similar skill levels, and shared gaming preferences. You swipe through potential teammates who meet YOUR criteria, skip awkward cold messaging, and only connect with players who are genuinely available when you want to play.

The difference? You're not shouting into a void hoping someone responds. You're seeing only people who already match your availability, speak your language, and play your games. Less time spamming 'LFG' in chat, more time in-game with people you'll actually want to team up with again.

q2.question: How to meet gamers online and build a gaming friend group?
q2.answer:
Finding gamers is easy. Finding RIGHT gamers is where everyone fails.

You need teammates who are available when you play, communicate in your language, and match your skill level. That's not too much to ask — it's bare minimum.

What actually works:
• Filter before you commit — Browse player profiles with verified stats, availability, and playstyle before connecting
• Prioritize compatibility — Timezone, rank, and communication style matter more than just playing same game
• Build gradually — Focus on finding 2-3 solid teammates rather than joining mega-communities where meaningful connections are harder to form

Avoid platforms that force you to spam 'LFG' and hope for responses. Your time is worth more than that.

q3.question: How to find teammates for ranked games in League of Legends and Valorant?
q3.answer:
Finding good ranked teammates isn't about quantity — it's about compatibility. Playing with randoms who don't communicate, rage quit after first blood, or play roles they're not comfortable with costs you LP and sanity.

What to look for in ranked teammates:
• Verified rank — Make sure they're actually at your ELO (not smurfing or boosted)
• Role compatibility — Check their champion pool and preferred roles before queuing
• Consistent availability — Ranked grinding requires regular play — find people with similar schedules
• Communication style — Some players prefer shotcalling, others want minimal chat. Match this upfront.

The best approach? Use platforms that verify player ranks through Riot's API and let you filter by role, schedule, and communication preferences. You'll spend less time in champ select dodging and more time climbing. We wrote the guide on finding League teammates — and here's how AI matchmaking actually works under the hood.

q4.question: What are the best alternatives to Discord for finding gaming teammates?
q4.answer:
Discord is great for chatting with teammates you ALREADY have. For finding new ones? It's the wrong tool.

Here's reality: Posting 'LFG' in a server with 10,000 members means your message gets buried in minutes. You have no way to filter by skill level, availability, or playstyle before reaching out. And most importantly — you're doing all the work. Spamming channels, DMing strangers, hoping someone responds.

What you actually need is a platform designed for discovery:
• Player profiles — See someone's rank, schedule, and preferred roles BEFORE messaging
• Smart filtering — Search by criteria that matter (language, timezone, skill level)
• Active matching — Get recommendations instead of shouting into the void

The goal isn't to replace Discord — it's to use the right tool for discovery, then move to Discord for voice chat once you've found compatible teammates. See how LFG evolved from forums to smart matchmaking.

q5.question: Are there free gaming matchmaking apps and platforms?
q5.answer:
Yes, and you shouldn't have to pay just to find teammates. Many platforms offer robust free tiers that include the essentials: player discovery, profile browsing, chat, and session planning.

What to expect from free tiers:
• Core matchmaking features (search, filter, connect)
• Player profiles with stats
• Basic messaging and session scheduling

What premium tiers usually add:
• Unlimited daily matches/swipes
• Advanced filters (very specific criteria)
• Cosmetic upgrades (badges, profile customization)

Red flags to avoid:
• Paywalling basic features like messaging or seeing who matched with you
• Forcing you to pay to verify your rank or link accounts
• No free tier at all (if they're confident in their product, they should let you try it)

Your time is more valuable than subscription fees. Focus on platforms with generous free tiers so you can test before committing.
